purpose: Ingest the full user-supplied Claude Code XENO vector-language measurement package into ongoing Clay research and bind future triggerwort-2 training-data work and go harness work to its evidence while preserving observation/inference/hypothesis boundaries.

source_package.inventory_note: The archive additionally contains duplicate ABI directories, NPY ABI artifacts, measurement scripts and the PDF specification. Their authoritative hashes remain in the supplied ABI MANIFEST and source archive; this ingest records the package hash and all material text/measurement identities without promoting binary copies into canonical truth.

authority_at_ingest.note: The 2026-08-24 fast bootstrap snapshot at 8.63 is stale for current authority; measurements remain source evidence but do not override newer owner/supervisor authority.

target_model_identity.model_specificity: All measured numerical claims are scoped to this exact measured snapshot unless separately replicated.

geometry.conclusion: Centering is mandatory before similarity/geometry operations; effective global rank remains under-sampled with 149 prompts.

binding_capacity.conclusion: Binding algebra is not the current bottleneck for k<=16.

semantic_rank.conclusion: A single direction is insufficient; semantic content behaves as a low-rank subspace (roughly rank 2-4 in measured probes). Rank-3 is a conservative ABI design choice, not a proof of universal semantic rank.

read_write_profile.semantic_readability: 0.94-1.00 from about L6 onward on the measured lexically separated task family
read_write_profile.conclusion: Reading and symbol-axis writing work; dynamic context-dependent binding between them is the missing capability.

alphabet.conclusion: Use the 46 accepted orthogonalized contrast-centered symbol atoms; orthogonalization materially reduces cross-talk.

codec.conclusion: The supplied linear codec is numerically stable enough in float64; nonlinear/lossy codecs have no inherited credit.

structure_task.conclusion: The measured fantasy-predicate structural target is not represented well enough for static steering to recover the missing dynamic binding.

context_invariance.conclusion: Within-template decoding can be perfect while cross-template semantic binding remains poor, especially into the codebook task.

abi_selftest_reperformed_by_gpt56sol.scope: ABI_REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY; NOT MODEL TRAINING OR WHOLE HCU CREDIT

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: bipolar MAP makes product self-inverse and restores 1.0 capacity through k=16

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.issue: Initial raw-state capacity decline interpreted as binding capacity limit
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: centering/whitening restores performance to 1.0 through k=16

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.issue: Low cross-task direction correlation interpreted as context-dependent atoms
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.cause: one compared structural task had no decodable representation
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: claim vacated; context invariance measured separately across four individually decodable templates

protect_do_not_retrain_as_primary_object: symbol emission axis already measured writable
HRR/MAP carrier-space binding algebra already measured sufficient through k=16
training_objective_from_evidence.interpretation: Training should install a content-dependent variable-binding/routing computation that maps currently decoded semantics through the episode-local codebook to the correct symbol, while preserving existing read/write/carrier functions.

dataset_requirements_from_source: Use full S3 permutation family for three-class codebooks, not cyclic rotations
Draw symbols per episode from the 46-atom ABI, with dedicated unseen-symbol holdout
Lexical families must be split to prevent semantic-word leakage; protocol/codebook tokens need an explicit exemption policy rather than pretending every literal token can be disjoint
Do not leak the target semantic class outside the codebook/metadata boundary
Randomize codebook entry order and example positions
Use at least four structurally different training templates plus a separate frozen unseen-template holdout
Keep output-token length controlled; the provided accepted atom list is single-token under the measured tokenizer
Bind every row to exact ABI manifest and generator/source provenance
Use family-level splits and freeze holdouts before tuning

source_spec_internal_tension.class_word_rule: 00_AUFTRAG section 4 says no class words such as ALLOW in model text, while section 3 episode format explicitly places ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN inside the codebook.
source_spec_internal_tension.research_resolution: Treat class labels as permitted only inside the episode-local codebook definition (or replace them with label-free demonstrations in a separately versioned successor); prohibit target-class leakage outside that codebook. This resolution must be preregistered before dataset freeze.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: 03_generator_geruest.py chooses perm only for protocol logging; actual cb_paare construction ignores perm.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: holdout_permutation does not test unseen permutation generalization; it is a metadata-only split.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: construct actual class<->symbol mapping from the selected S3 permutation and derive the target symbol from that mapping.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: validator passes len(perms)>=3; production requirement is the full relevant S3 coverage.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: partial permutations can be reported as valid.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: check exact expected permutation IDs per split and actual mapping realization, not only metadata IDs.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: max relative deviation threshold is <0.5 despite source requiring complete counterbalancing.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: enforce exact or at-most-one count differences and near-zero mutual information with deterministic expected counts.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: the code computes leakage candidates then hardcodes ok=True.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: target-class leakage can never fail validation.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: parse codebook span separately and fail if class labels/synonyms occur in situation/query/answer context outside allowed span.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: validator compares hashes of only the sampled target adjective and ignores subjects/template lexical material.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: split leakage can pass while prompts reuse semantic-bearing vocabulary.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: explicitly define protected protocol tokens and compare normalized semantic-bearing lexemes/families across train/val/holdout.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: training excludes T4 and validator accepts >=3 training templates although source asks for at least four structurally distinct templates.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: context-invariance training pressure is weaker than specified.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: provide >=4 training templates and reserve an additional structurally novel template family for holdout D.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: vocab_hash is only a 16-hex prefix of SHA256 over one sampled word.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: weak provenance and not a true vocabulary-family hash.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: hash the canonical full lexical-family inventory with full SHA-256 and optionally record row-level lexeme hashes separately.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: generator records target_symbol_atom_row and manifest hash but does not independently assert row/atom mapping or manifest file hashes.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: silent ABI/data mismatch could survive generation.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: load and verify ABI manifest hashes, atom row mapping, model/tokenizer identity, and source archive/generator version before emitting rows.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: T4 appears in val although it is the designated holdout_schablone.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: model weights are not trained on val, but human/hyperparameter selection can indirectly tune to the nominal holdout template.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: keep the frozen template family absent from both train and validation; use a separate calibration-template set if needed.

cycle: emit versioned dataset delta + falsifiers + no-credit boundary
swarm_logic_for_future_triggerwort_2.non_negotiable: Reviewers must be allowed to reject the generator/tests themselves; validator greenness is not self-authenticating evidence.

go_harness_research_return.binding: The Xeno harness must consume the same exact ABI/protocol assumptions that the triggerwort-2 dataset teaches.
required_interfaces: L23 write hook and L19/L21 observation hooks when model-specific measurements are used
float64 codec artifacts if this ABI is used
trace fields linking semantic decision -> codebook lookup -> emitted symbol
strict S0/S1/S2 and coordinator authority boundaries from current EntityOS/HCU owner target
go_harness_research_return.acceptance_link: Harness evaluation must use the same frozen unseen-symbol, unseen-permutation, unseen-vocabulary, and unseen-template families plus retention tests, and must not infer J-Space causality from output accuracy alone.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: The missing dynamic binding may depend heavily on attention-mediated routing because the target operation is content-dependent and full-attention layers occur at 3/7/11/15/19/23.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: matched adapter/full-FT interventions that improve binding equivalently without relying on those attention pathways, or causal lesion evidence showing another module is necessary/sufficient.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: A small learned routing circuit may be sufficient because semantic decoding and symbol writeout are already present and carrier algebra is not limiting.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: training requires broad model changes or cannot preserve read/write capabilities under narrow intervention.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: Focusing loss/curriculum on episodic remapping should reduce catastrophic interference versus retraining semantics/symbol output.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: narrow training fails while broader retraining improves held-out binding without >2% retention loss.

acceptance_contract.causal_post_training_test: After a binding circuit exists, lesion it while preserving semantic readability; symbol choice must fail, then rescue must restore symbol choice. Pre-training this lesion test is not meaningful because the binder is already absent.
acceptance_contract.statistical_rule: Thresholds alone are insufficient; report uncertainty/significance and damage/retention bounds.

next_exact_actions: Replace the generator permutation metadata path with a permutation-causal constructor and hard validator.
Resolve/preregister the class-word/codebook exception and lexical-disjointness definition.
Expand to >=4 training templates plus a fifth frozen unseen template and enforce family-level split isolation.
Add full ABI/source provenance checks and deterministic leakage/counterbalance tests.
Generate a small audited seed first; swarm-review it before scaling to 20k-50k training rows.
Use future exact triggerwort 2 cycles to evolve dataset/recipe/evaluation from new Claude measurements; use exact go cycles to evolve the ABI-compatible Xeno harness.
